label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Players Returning
items.text: With Saudi PIF funding ending after 2026, up to five former LIV Golf players, including Brooks Koepka, could rejoin the PGA Tour by 2027.

items.headline: Unusual FedEx St. Jude Field
items.text: A back injury has reduced the FedEx St. Jude Championship field to an unusual 69 players.

items.headline: McIlroy's Light Schedule
items.text: Rory McIlroy has played a very light PGA Tour schedule so far in 2026.
